info.title: Go Server API
info.description:
API specification for the Go Server application with account management, authentication, and workspace functionality.

## Services
- **Account Service**: User account management and email verification
- **Session Service**: Authentication and session management
- **Workspace Service**: Workspace creation and member management

## Authentication
The API uses JWT tokens for authentication. Include the access token in the Authorization header: `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`

## Data Types
- Timestamps are stored as epoch seconds (Unix timestamp)
- UUIDs are used for primary keys
- All responses include success status and message fields

post.description: Register a new user account with email verification

get.description: Verify email address using verification token from URL

post.description: Verify email address using verification token in request body
Resend email verification to the specified email address
Authenticate user and receive access and refresh tokens
Logout user by invalidating refresh token
Logout user from all active sessions
Get new access token using refresh token
Create a new workspace for the authenticated user

delete.description: Delete a workspace (only owner can delete)

403.description: Forbidden - Only owner can delete workspace

post.description: Invite new members to join the workspace
Remove existing members from the workspace

put.description: Modify the access level of a workspace member

get.description: Check if the service is running and healthy

account_id.description: Account ID to logout from all sessions
